metadata.title: Add a short bio to user profiles · example

slides.title: A little more context on each profile
slides.subtitle: People can add a short bio. Leaving it blank keeps their profile just as it is today.

slides.title: Existing profiles keep working
slides.caption: The new field is optional. Existing rows need no backfill, and a bio can be added whenever someone is ready.
slides.diff:
diff --git a/db/migrations/add_profile_bio.sql b/db/migrations/add_profile_bio.sql
--- a/db/migrations/add_profile_bio.sql
+++ b/db/migrations/add_profile_bio.sql
@@ -0,0 +1,2 @@
+ALTER TABLE users
+  ADD COLUMN bio VARCHAR(280) NULL;

callouts.note: Allowing NULL makes the change compatible with existing profiles.

slides.title: The limit belongs on the server too
slides.caption: The editor helps people stay within 280 characters. The API enforces that limit for every caller.

callouts.note: Direct API requests cannot bypass the editor’s length limit.
Trim surrounding whitespace before saving the bio.

slides.title: Keep the same permission boundary
slides.caption: Editing a bio uses the existing profile guard, so access stays limited to the owner and administrators.

callouts.note: This route reuses the profile permission check.
callouts.why: Review the guard’s behavior for requests that target someone else’s profile.
